queries.compiledQueryString: select week, weeks_of_supply from (select * from pps.fg_weekly) where weeks_of_supply is not null order by week
queries.inputQueryString: select week, weeks_of_supply from ${fg} where weeks_of_supply is not null order by week

queries.compiledQueryString:
-- finished-goods turns, trailing 52 weeks: kg shipped / average kg on hand
select sum(shipped_kg) / avg(on_hand_kg) as fg_turns,
       avg(weeks_of_supply)              as avg_weeks_of_supply
from (select * from (select * from pps.fg_weekly) order by week desc limit 52)
queries.inputQueryString:
-- finished-goods turns, trailing 52 weeks: kg shipped / average kg on hand
select sum(shipped_kg) / avg(on_hand_kg) as fg_turns,
       avg(weeks_of_supply)              as avg_weeks_of_supply
from (select * from ${fg} order by week desc limit 52)
